item.title: 🟠 Binance Reveals How Fake Job Interviews and AI Tool Abuse Led to $6.43 Billion Theft
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and watch for suspicious sign-ins.

"It was not a single isolated breach or a simple phishing incident,"

item.title: 🟠 Barracuda Flaws Could Be Chained to Bypass Authorization and Gain Root Access
item.description:
Why this matters: Could affect sign-ins, MFA, or Conditional Access — watch for authentication issues.
Barracuda has disclosed details of two vulnerabilities affecting its products that, if chained together, could allow an attacker to bypass authorization controls and gain root access to a susceptible device. The vulnerabilities, a pre-authentication authorization bypass vulnerability and a command injection vulnerability, have been assigned the CVE identifiers CVE-2026-116606 (CVSS score: 9.3)

Source: The Hacker News  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 1h
